notes: A broken vision endpoint no longer takes the whole reply down with it. Sending a photo in a mature conversation routed the reply through your own vision endpoint, and if that endpoint could not serve, nothing came back at all — the photo sat there and the character never answered. Now the pixels are dropped and the turn continues on the text model: the character is told the photo did not come through and asked to ask you about it, rather than inventing what it saw. The photo itself is not sent anywhere else — falling back with the image would hand an explicit picture to exactly the provider the self-hosted endpoint exists to avoid — and the app says plainly that it replied without reading it.
